subject: QBR headcount check-in: OKR alignment and freeze exception request
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
To: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 08:30:00 -0700
Subject: QBR headcount check-in: OKR alignment and freeze exception request

Team —

As we prep for the QBR next week I want to flag a single backfill that I believe should be handled as a freeze-exception: Req 475 (Senior Infrastructure Engineer, platform reliability). This role is directly tied to two Q3 OKRs: 1) reduce 95th percentile tail latency by 20% for hosted inference, and 2) improve KV cache hit rate across the fleet. Losing coverage here would materially increase risk to our latency SLOs and to the rollout schedule for the caching work.

Quick ask: can we approve an exception to the hiring freeze for Req 475 and commit to owner-level approval by EOD Thursday so recruiting can continue outreach? I attached the req summary and a 1-slide excerpt from the QBR headcount deck with impact estimates.

Context bullets:
- Business impact: target product launch dependent on infra improvements; customer pilot (Nimbus) is at stake.
- Cost: mid-senior comp band, hire-to-start timeline ~6–8 weeks if we prioritize.
- Alternatives considered: contractor temp (2 months) — high onboarding cost, lower throughput; redistribution of existing SREs — will delay other initiatives.

If you want a short cost/benefit table or ROI metric I can produce it this afternoon. Otherwise I recommend we approve the exception and route to Tessa for procurement and req activation.

Thanks,
Irene
Irene Choi
VP, Platform Engineering
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Req_475-Infrastructure_Backfill.docx (req summary), QBR_headcount_slides.pdf (1-slide impact)
From: Markus Klein <markus.klein@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Tessa Morgan <tessa.morgan@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR headcount check-in: OKR alignment and freeze exception request

Irene —

Thanks for the write-up. Two quick clarifying questions before I commit:
1) Do you have the estimated incremental revenue or cost avoidance tied to the Nimbus pilot if we meet the latency target? Put differently, what's the near-term business delta?
2) If we approve the exception, can you confirm the headcount will not cascade into additional reqs this quarter (i.e., single-point exception)?

If you can drop a short ROI table and the updated impact slide I can greenlight pending Vanessa's alignment.

-Markus

Subject: Re: QBR headcount check-in: OKR alignment and freeze exception request

Irene / Markus —

I read the slide and agree the role maps to Q3 OKRs and to the Nimbus pilot. Two operational notes:
- We should require a 6-month check-in tied to the OKR metric (95th pctl latency) as a condition of the exception.
- Please include a short risk register row in the req (3 bullets max) listing service areas impacted if we do not fill.

If those two conditions are in the req summary I am comfortable with approval. Markus — assuming those are present, do you want me to sign off or should we route to exec payroll approval?

-Vanessa

Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 13:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: QBR headcount check-in: OKR alignment and freeze exception request

Markus / Vanessa —

Thanks for the quick responses. Attached is a 1-page ROI snapshot I put together (excerpted from the QBR deck): it shows estimated ARR impact from keeping the Nimbus pilot on track (~$480k incremental over 12 months if we meet latency targets) and a conservative operational cost avoidance figure if we avoid cascading incident remediation (~$120k). I also added a single-row risk register and a 6-month OKR check-in milestone to the req doc.

Given Vanessa's conditionals are satisfied, I recommend we approve the exception now and route to Tessa to spin up the req and notify recruiting. Tessa — can you start activation today and add the 6-month check-in to recruiting/hiring notes?

If Markus wants to loop exec payroll for a formal signature I am fine with that as a follow-up; my ask is for owner-level approval to proceed.

Cheers,
Irene

Attachments: Req_475-Infrastructure_Backfill.docx (updated with risk row and 6-month check-in), ROI_snapshot_QBR_exerpt.pdf
